'''mrwaltdog Rescue The Princess''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 28 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Detention Block Corridor|SE-L-deathstardetentionblockcorridor.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Detention Block Corridor
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Death Star Detention Block Corrid.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Thankx for the feedback. I have made a bunch of changes and improved the deck. Let me know what you think.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I can draw Artoo with Cell 2187 (V) and then use his game text to draw Hero Of A Thousand Devices, which then lets me draw the Fire Extinguisher for battle canceling after I rescue the princess using the lift tube and Artoo. Flip on turn three usually. Use The Signal to Get Bacta Tank out asap other effects are good as well. Death Star Plans are for retreival of course. Fallen Portal to keep people away from the docking bays and to help Leia. THe mains are used to go beatdown on opponent while using Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) to get their sabers as well.

P.S. I liked the changes that were recomended by Revelation and Shewski. Thankx again.
